title: Review storage
help: Previews and final cuts for review on the admin live here. When it is full, new videos cannot be sent (review store full); previews of published videos are cleared on their own, but final cuts that are ready to publish keep their space until they go up.
failed: Could not read the review storage. Try again.
diskUnknown: The host disk's free space could not be read
nearlyFull: Nearly full: publish or delete videos you no longer need, or raise the limit.
limitHelp: A whole number from 1 to 500. It applies as soon as you save; no redeploy.
overDisk: This limit is more than what is used plus the disk's free space; the disk would fill first.
conflict: Someone else just changed this setting. Read it again, then save.
readOnly: You can see the usage. Changing the limit needs settings management.
invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 500.
